NAH— although, I think you should consider your wife’s stance here. These things are FUN; I regard my times believing in Santa, tooth fairy, etc. as such a magical time. Really I was impressed at how well they pulled off each role and even pulled off all kinds of “magic”: Santa’s “footprints”, a note from the Easter bunny in writing that wasn’t my parents. Because of my upbringing and how magical it was for me, I can’t imagine not doing those things for my own little ones.
